summary.text: Joe Nicola, a Republican, represents Missouri Senate District 11, part of Jackson County, and took the oath of office on January 8, 2025.
He is vice-chair of the Senate Families, Seniors and Health Committee and chairs the Task Force on Substance Abuse Prevention and Treatment.

paragraphs.text: Nicola joined the U.S. Navy Seabees in 1984 and served until 1990.
In 1986 he started a motorcycle shop, Vision Cycles, in Kansas City and ran it for nearly a decade.

He served as a youth minister from 1990 to 1999, is the founding pastor of New Covenant Ministries in Independence, worked for the Blue Springs School District from 1999 to 2017, and has authored two theological books.

His Senate biography says that in the 2026 session he passed the No Foreign Laws Act and the Act Against Abusive Website Access Litigation, and that Senate Bill 878 included his legislation on pharmacist dispensing of ivermectin and hydroxychloroquine.
Nicola lives in Grain Valley with his wife, Renee, to whom he has been married for 42 years.
